title: Quantifying the Vulnerabilities of the Online Public Square to Adversarial Manipulation Tactics

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the impact on overall network information quality when malicious actors preferentially target authentic social media users based on their political partisanship scores (liberal vs. conservative) using an agent-based information diffusion model.

Simulating information diffusion to measure how social media feed algorithms that prioritize social engagement, recency, and content appeal over intrinsic quality allow inauthentic accounts to suppress high-quality information through flooding and deception.

Modeling a 'deception parameter' to quantify how the spread of misinformation is exacerbated when bad actors generate low-quality content with deceptively high appeal, exploiting users' natural bias towards appealing or novel messages.
